title: One shift adds the item everywhere
hook: One shift can extend many subsets while still using one item only once.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary masks, basic complex arithmetic for FFT, polynomial coefficients.
doesNotKnow: Update reachable subset totals with bits OR shifted bits while keeping a single-use snapshot.

misconception: A bit shift changes only one candidate subset total.
objective: Update reachable subset totals with bits OR shifted bits while keeping a single-use snapshot.

claims.text: The shift adds the new item to every previously reachable total simultaneously. Reading an unmodified snapshot prevents a just-created total from using that same item again. The ascending scalar comparison deliberately permits reuse and therefore reaches extra totals.
